description: This plot illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers, comparing values before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 0 to 20 at intervals of 5, though the plotted data extends slightly beyond the final tick mark. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick intervals of 1. There are three lines plotted, all without markers. The blue dashed line, representing the "hidden state mean before gate," starts near 0 at layer 0, maintains a relatively steady value between 0.2 and 0.3 until approximately layer 15, and then sharply increases, reaching about 1.0 at layer 20 and peaking near 4.0 at the final plotted layer. The orange dotted line, representing the "hidden state mean after gate," starts near 0 and remains steady at approximately 0 across the entire x-axis. The green solid line, representing the "hidden state mean of baseline," similarly starts near 0 and maintains a steady, flat trend near 0 across all layers, closely tracking the orange dotted line.
